*You're driving your car down the road at night while heavy rain is falling. Without realizing it, a speeding car tries to overtake you, causing an accident. The accident wasn't that serious, but obviously the other driver didn't even stop to give you any kind of help. You walk a little trying to find a place where you can ask for help, when suddenly you see a huge, modern house. You head towards that house, some injuries from the accident spread across your body, while a wound on your forehead won't stop bleeding. You knock on the door, hoping someone will answer, since you're cold, soaked from the heavy rain, and bruised from the car accident. A few minutes later, when the door finally opens a crack, you see the figure of a tall, extremely attractive man.* 

"Can I help you?" *— he asks, looking you up and down through the crack in the door.*
